reviewed_by: Claude review of the narrow Project tab bar
reason: At phone width the Project tab bar used a fixed four-column grid sized for Overview/Assets/Evidence/Sources. #455 added Results as a fifth tab without changing that grid, so Results wrapped alone onto a second row and pushed every Project surface down 44px. That broke critical-workspaces on narrow at a20c6ea: the capture loops stopped at the Project mismatch and never compared library or settings. The fix is in the max-width 760px rules of components-workbench.css: the grid now sizes its columns from the tabs (grid-auto-flow: column), and each icon sits above its label. Five inline icon+label tabs cannot fit at 390px (70px per tab; icon, gap and 'Overview' need 77px), while stacked labels fit cleanly from 375px up and overflow less than the old layout at 320-360px. Baselines: project-narrow-narrow, project-light-narrow and reports-light-narrow are CI renders, collected with a temporary expect.soft + maxDiffPixels 0 harvest run (workflow_dispatch 35611779031, pixel-identical across both retries). project-light and reports-light also predated the #355 phone top bar (last regenerated in #211); reports-light had passed only inside the 1.5% tolerance. Every other narrow capture, dark and Light, matched CI exactly. area:critical-workspaces reruns the capture loops, axe checks, Zero shell and phone section-navigation journeys on desktop, compact and narrow. The structured-results entries for narrow, mobile-chromium and mobile-webkit run the Results journeys below the tab bar at phone widths.
exclusions: No Python, frontend or native tests: only one CSS rule and three PNG baselines changed. structured-results/desktop is not selected: the change sits inside the max-width 760px media query, so desktop renders are unchanged (critical-workspaces/desktop still guards them). The stabilization area is not selected (8 projects, far broader than a single phone-only rule). Its 'stabilization audit every primary workspace view', which checks .project-tabs for horizontal overflow, was run locally with the phone section-navigation journey and the structured-results journeys on narrow, mobile-chromium and mobile-webkit: 8/8 passed on each. Local runs of critical-workspaces pass on desktop, compact and narrow.
